title: OVMS Metric Metric Value Leaderboard
dataSources: Tesla vehicle/charge state (`tesla:vehicle`, `tesla:charge`), TeslaMate MQTT/Postgres, OBD-II PIDs (`obd:pid`), Smartcar API (`smartcar:vehicle`), EV charger sessions (`evcharger:session`).
app: Tesla Fleet API / TeslaMate, Teslafi, and generic OBD-II / Smartcar / manufacturer APIs via HEC scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ovms:metric value_num=*
| stats sum(value_num) as total_value, avg(value_num) as avg_value by metric_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks metric values by total and average metric value across Open Vehicles metric events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `value_num` values for each Open Vehicles metric event and review total and average metric value by metric.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total metric value.
grandmaExplanation: It quietly keeps which metric shows the biggest metric value numbers in your Open Vehicles metric data.
